description: Hand-curated competency mapping for NYSC COURSE-040 Automobile Mechanic (part-time) against its linked benchmarking records. A DOCUMENTED cell cites the exact stored module, outcome, or unit text that names the competency. NOT_EXPLICIT means the available description does not name it, not that it is absent from teaching. INSUFFICIENT_DATA means the stored curriculum is unavailable or outside the record's documented scope.
method: The NYSC column was assessed by hand against COURSE-040's own five published module headings only; a broad heading does not establish a more specific competency. Comparator cells are reused unchanged from competency_mapping_course-005.json because the comparator records and their cited text are identical. Coverage (FULL/PARTIAL) and the status definitions are recorded in 'methodology'; category components are in 'category_components'. Corrections from the 2026-10-17 evidence audit were applied. The CGTTI column was reassessed on 2026-10-17 after its published curriculum was captured.

methodology.DOCUMENTED: The cited stored text explicitly names the competency. Coverage records whether it names every component of the category (FULL) or only some (PARTIAL).
methodology.FULL: The cited evidence supports the competency as labelled: every listed component of the category is explicitly named.
methodology.PARTIAL: Only a component of the category, or a lower level of activity (for example awareness or identification), is explicitly documented; supported_component records what is supported.
methodology.NOT_EXPLICIT: The competency is not documented within the available, assessed scope of the source.
methodology.INSUFFICIENT_DATA: Missing or incomplete material (uncaptured wording, unstored modules, or uncollected sibling standards) prevents a reliable assessment.
methodology.caution: None of these statuses proves that a competency is or is not actually taught.
methodology.areas_rule: Areas to Investigate list competencies that the NYSC description does not name (NOT_EXPLICIT) and that at least two distinct comparator records, from at least two different countries, document with FULL coverage. PARTIAL evidence is shown but not counted.
